short.en: Real-time ingestion for structured and unstructured data with exactly-once semantics.
short.zh: 为结构化与非结构化数据提供实时接入，支持精确一次（exactly-once）语义。

description.en: Ingest is the front door of every QN丨CMS deployment. It connects to over 60 sources — Kafka, S3, Postgres, Snowflake, and more — and normalizes the stream into a uniform format your downstream services trust. Backpressure-aware pipelines keep latency low even during traffic spikes.
description.zh: Ingest 是每个 青柠丨CMS 部署的入口。它连接 60 多种数据源——Kafka、S3、Postgres、Snowflake 等——并将数据流归一化为下游服务可信赖的统一格式。具备背压感知能力的管道即使在流量高峰时也保持低延迟。

zh: 支持时间旅行的 Schema 注册表

short.en: Visual DAG orchestration for complex, multi-step data pipelines.
short.zh: 面向复杂多步骤数据管道的可视化 DAG 编排。

description.en: Orchestrate turns brittle cron jobs and hand-rolled glue code into declarative, dependency-aware workflows. Each node — transform, call, branch, or fan-out — is observed, retried, and replayable. Define the graph visually, then export it as code for version control.
description.zh: Orchestrate 将脆弱的 cron 任务与手工胶水代码转变为声明式、具备依赖感知的可观测工作流。每个节点——转换、调用、分支或扇出——都可被观测、重试与重放。可视化定义有向图，再导出为代码纳入版本管理。

zh: 拖拽式 DAG 设计器
声明式、可版本化的定义

short.en: A blazing-fast query engine over petabyte-scale data, with a no-code BI surface.
short.zh: 面向 PB 级数据的极速查询引擎，附带无代码 BI 界面。

description.en: Analytics pairs a columnar, vectorized engine with a self-serve BI canvas. Analysts can explore with drag-and-drop charts, while engineers issue ANSI SQL with sub-second response even across 100TB. Caches and materialized views keep hot dashboards instant.
description.zh: Analytics 将列式向量化引擎与自助式 BI 画布相结合。分析师可用拖拽式图表进行探索，工程师则可执行 ANSI SQL，即便跨 100TB 数据也能亚秒级响应。缓存与物化视图让高频仪表盘保持即时刷新。

zh: 无代码 BI + 完整 ANSI SQL

short.en: Unified metrics, logs, and traces with adaptive, cost-aware sampling.
short.zh: 统一的指标、日志与链路追踪，支持自适应、成本感知采样。

description.en: Observe unifies metrics, logs, and distributed traces in one pane. Adaptive sampling keeps cost predictable while preserving the signals that matter — anomalies first. Blameless, correlated debugging replaces the hours of log archaeology.
description.zh: Observe 将指标、日志与分布式链路追踪汇聚到同一面板。自适应采样让成本可预测，同时保留真正重要的信号——异常优先。无指责、强关联的调试取代了过去数小时的海量日志翻找。

zh: 指标、日志、链路追踪统一
